p.bio: I started sailing at the age of 11 in the Optimist class and have remained passionate about the sport ever since. Over the years, I have represented Seychelles at numerous national and regional sailing events, with one of my proudest achievements being winning Gold at the Indian Ocean Island Games. Today, I continue to compete while also serving as a part time Sailing Coach, helping to develop the next generation of Seychellois sailors. I am passionate about growing the sport in Seychelles and creating more opportunities for young athletes to succeed both locally and internationally. Outside of sailing, I enjoy fitness training, spending time in my home garden, and staying connected to nature. Looking ahead, I hope to continue contributing to the growth of sailing in Seychelles while inspiring more young people to discover the opportunities and lifelong lessons that the sport can offer.
